0.title: Welcome to Binaver Foldex Enterprise!
0.subtitle: Governance, automation, and high-performance file triage
0.description: Foldex eliminates the manual rework of organizing folders, spreadsheets, and documents. In strict compliance with GDPR, all processing occurs 100% on your computer, with auditable forensic security.
0.h1: No file uploads to the cloud (Zero-Knowledge)
0.h3: Compatible with any local or network folder

1.title: 1. 1-Click Smart Organize
1.subtitle: Clean up the mess with just one click
1.description: Tired of folders like "Downloads" full of mixed files? Use the "Auto-Organize Folder" button. Foldex's engine creates categories automatically (Documents, Spreadsheets, Images) and moves everything to the right places.
1.h1: Instant categorization without needing to create rules
1.h3: 100% reversible action on the Audit screen

2.title: 2. Custom Rule Builder
2.subtitle: How to create and customize your own triage routines
2.description: For specific workflows, create detailed rules by combining criteria such as extensions (.pdf, .xlsx), dates, or names. Define whether files should be moved, copied, renamed, or deleted in batches.
2.h2: Multiple filters combined with AND or OR logic
2.h3: Pre-configured quick templates to optimize time

3.title: 3. Real-Time Autopilot
3.subtitle: Continuous automation without human intervention
3.description: By turning on the "Automatic" button on any rule, Foldex silently monitors the folder in the background. As soon as a new file is detected, it is classified and processed instantly.
3.h1: Native monitoring via operating system events
3.h3: Security Alert for active GDPR Mode

4.title: 4. File Explorer & Vaults
4.subtitle: Directory management and AES-256 security
4.description: Navigate through your disks with instant speed. Use the native menu to compress folders and create .ZIP Vaults protected with military-grade AES-256 encryption, requiring a password for extraction.
4.h2: Ultra-fast access to network drives and system disks
4.h3: Pin favorite folders on the side panel

5.title: 5. Secure Simulation (Dry-Run)
5.subtitle: See the result before moving real files
5.description: Before applying a new rule to folders with thousands of documents, use the Simulation screen to check exactly where each file will go, ensuring total predictability and zero operational errors.
5.h1: Detailed From -> To preview in memory
5.h2: Exact count of files that meet the filters

6.title: 6. Forensic Audit & Undo (Rollback)
6.subtitle: Total peace of mind: restore any operation in 1 click
6.description: All actions (manual, automatic, or autonomous) are logged with date, operator, and SHA-256 hash. If you organize something by mistake, just select the files or the batch and click "Revert".
6.h1: Atomic restoration without data loss or corruption
